description:
Hi, I’m Daniel, a member of Albania’s national robotics team. I do competitive programming (Java, C++, Python) and have built Flutter apps, a robot simulator and a bionic arm. I cover coding, algorithms and hardware, and I finish what I start with a polished result.

Looking for:

A data science/astronomy person to read NASA datasets and keep our approach scientifically sound

A strong presenter to lead the pitch and video
